title: 第19章 振翅横绝九天第20章 李师弟你饭量大吗3k

;;
半山腰，道观。
定光在灶房烧了火，把饭早早焖上，便扒着门框，探着小脑袋往道观正殿望。
今夜道观，来了两位客人，一位与师兄同龄，另一位则是位白须老者。
……
道观中。
檀香袅袅。
“守心前辈，一别六十年，我们终于又见了！”
一位身材高大的白须老者拱手笑道，虽已年迈，但依旧精神矍铄，笑声爽朗。
他看着比守心还要苍老，却是口称前辈。
守心道长不置可否地点了点头，目光落在一旁的白衣少年身上。
此刻，在鱼吞舟口中“和善好相处”
的老道长，微笑对面前的年轻人道：
“你家大人没告诉你，上了山，先给本座磕三个响头？”
白须老者笑容顿时僵住，张了张嘴想开口打圆场，却还是苦笑着摇了摇头。
少年人笑容和煦，听到这句话，不仅没有半分尴尬、不解、愤怒，反而神色因此庄重肃穆了起来，抬手抖了抖袖口，就要跪下行大礼。
白须老者眼观鼻鼻观心，干脆闭了眼，权当未曾看见。
他心中门清，这两位都是他，乃至是他师兄当下，都招惹不起的人物。
一位是上清法脉的二老爷。
一位是来历不明，却令他大师兄都要郑重接待，命他护送其进入罗浮洞天的神秘少年。

眼看着年轻人一只脚已经屈膝，守心道长一挥手中雪白麈尾，淡淡道：
“罢了，本座可担不起你这三个响头。”
名为李景玄的少年，沉声道：“便是三百个，道君也当得起！”
白须老者松了口气。
此次护送李景玄，大师兄特意叮嘱了他，一定要小心这位守心道长，这两位疑似法脉之争……
而法脉之争，便是传承之争，大道之争，往往是不死不休的局面！
他这一路上都在盘算着如何避免冲突爆发，眼看如今双方各退一步，不仅喜笑颜开。
你瞧，你退一步，我捧一句，这不挺好的吗？皆大欢喜！
恰在此时，守心道长的目光已然落在了他身上，似笑非笑道：
“小周啊，你家大师兄没来？”
出身于天鹏道场的周天沉解释道：“本来应当是大师兄来的，但大师兄临时有事，已经动身前往了北溟洲。”
“北溟洲？”
老道长皱了皱眉，“那边不是说局势危如累卵吗？你师兄不怕身死异乡？”
“大师兄说了，当年祖师自北溟得道，而今北溟洲也大概率就是他的得道之地！”
谈起大师兄，周天沉目光熠熠，充满了自信，哪怕是老道长口中极度危险的北溟洲，他也坚信师兄能杀出一条通天大道！
“好气魄！”
便是守心道长，此刻也赞叹了一句，“不愧是有‘振翅横绝九天’之象的扶摇道人。”
周天沉咧嘴而笑，满脸皆是与有荣焉的自豪。
老道长话锋陡然一转：“所以这次，代表天鹏道场的镇守者，就是你？”
周天沉重重点头：“不错。

来前师兄嘱咐了我，说我们不争这一世，等他成就法相，再好好挑一位佳徒，重返此地，与诸家争他个一世高低！”
“这样啊。”
老道长微微点头，神色略显古怪，又看向一旁的年轻人，笑道，“那老东西让你来，是接任我的位置，还是顶替天鹏道场的名额？”
content_en:
;;
Halfway up the mountain, there is a Taoist temple.
Dingguang lit a fire in the kitchen and simmered the meal early. Then he lifted the door frame and poked his little head to look at the main hall of the Taoist temple.
Tonight, two guests came to the Taoist temple. One was the same age as his senior brother, and the other was an old man with a white beard.
…
In Taoist temple.
Sandalwood curls.
"Senior Shouxin, after sixty years of separation, we finally meet again!"
A tall old man with a white beard cupped his hands and smiled. Although he was old, he was still energetic and had a hearty laugh.
He looks older than Shouxin, but he calls himself senior.
Taoist priest Shouxin nodded noncommittally, his eyes falling on the young man in white beside him.
At this moment, Yu Tunzhou said "get along well with each other"
The old Taoist priest smiled and said to the young man in front of him:
"Didn't your elders tell you that when you go up the mountain, you should kowtow to me three times first?"
The white-bearded old man's smile suddenly froze, and he opened his mouth to smooth things over, but he still shook his head with a wry smile.
The young man smiled warmly. When he heard these words, not only was he not embarrassed, puzzled or angry, but his expression became solemn and solemn. He raised his hand and shook his sleeves before kneeling down to salute.
The white-bearded old man looked at his nose and heart, and simply closed his eyes, pretending that he had not seen it.
He knew clearly in his heart that these two people were people that he, not even his senior brother, could afford to offend at the moment.
One is the second master of Shangqing Dharma lineage.
One was a mysterious young man whose origin was unknown, but his elder brother received him solemnly and ordered him to escort him into the Luofu Cave.
Seeing that one of the young man's feet had already bent to the knee, Taoist Master Shouxin waved his hand and hit the snow-white tail, saying calmly:
"That's all, I can't afford your three bells."
The young man named Li Jingxuan said in a deep voice: "Even three hundred, Dao Lord can still afford it!"
The white-bearded old man breathed a sigh of relief.
When escorting Li Jingxuan this time, the senior brother specifically told him to be careful with Taoist Shouxin. These two people were suspected of fighting over their dharma lineage...
The battle for the dharma lineage is a battle for inheritance, and the battle for the avenues is often a life-and-death situation!
He had been thinking about how to avoid the conflict all along the way, and seeing both sides taking a step back, he was not only smiling.
Look, isn't it good if you take a step back and I compliment you? Everyone is happy!
At this moment, Taoist Shouxin's eyes had already fallen on him, and he said with a half-smile:
"Xiao Zhou, your senior brother isn't here?"
Zhou Tianchen, who was born in the Tianpeng Dojo, explained: "Originally, it was the senior brother who came, but the senior brother had something to do and had already left for Beimingzhou."
"Beimingzhou?"
The old Taoist priest frowned, "Didn't they say that the situation is extremely critical? Your senior brother is not afraid of dying in a foreign land?"
"Senior Brother said that the Patriarch attained enlightenment from Beiming back then, and now Beiming Continent is most likely the place where he attained enlightenment!"
When talking about his senior brother, Zhou Tianchen's eyes sparkled and he was full of confidence. Even in Beimingzhou, which the old Taoist leader said was extremely dangerous, he firmly believed that his senior brother could carve out a road to the sky!
"What a spirit!"
Even Taoist Master Shou Xin also praised him at this moment, "He is worthy of Taoist Fuyao who has the image of 'flying wings across the nine heavens'."
Zhou Tianchen grinned, his face full of pride.
The old Taoist leader suddenly changed the topic: "So this time, you are the guardian representing the Tianpeng Dojo?"
Zhou Tian nodded heavily: "Not bad.
Before I came here, my senior brother told me that we should not compete in this life. When he achieves the Dharma, we can then choose a good disciple and return to this place to compete with other families for his status in this life! "
"That's it."
The old Taoist priest nodded slightly, with a slightly weird look on his face, then looked at the young man aside and said with a smile, "The old man asked you to come, do you want to take over my position, or take the place in Tianpeng Dojo?"
